title: HSK 2.2 · 自己, 已经, 如果, 越来越, 经常
focus: 自己 · 得 · 已经 · 如果 · 只 · 当 · 带 · 不过 · 不要 · 通过 · 过去 · 结果 · 不错 · 要求 · 只要 · 不同 · 求 · 当时 · 真正 · 同时 · 越 · 来自 · 带来 · 过来 · 正常 · 那样 · 原来 · 怎样 · 经过 · 只能 · 经常 · 同样 · 越来越 · 主要 · 不少 · 超过 · 比如 · 后来 · 自由
body:
More connectors and adverbs: if, already, but, as long as, more and more. 过 (pass) is the star of this lesson, with 不, 同, 自, 来, 经 and 样 close behind.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 过 | guò | pass, go over (辶 + 寸) | 不过, 通过, 过去, 过来, 经过, 超过 |
| 不 | bù / bú | not | 不过, 不要, 不错, 不同, 不少 |
| 来 | lái | come | 带来, 过来, 原来, 越来越, 后来 |
| 同 | tóng | same | 不同, 同时, 同样 |
| 自 | zì | self; from | 自己, 来自, 自由 |
| 经 | jīng | pass through (纟 thread) | 已经, 经过, 经常 |
| 样 | yàng | kind, way | 那样, 怎样, 同样 |
| 只 | zhǐ | only | 只要, 只能 |

## Watch out

- 己 jǐ (self, open), 已 yǐ (already, half closed), 巳 sì (fully closed).
- 得 has three readings: toneless de after a verb (说得好), dé in 得到, děi = must.
- 要 is yāo (demand) in 要求, yào elsewhere.
- 只 is zhǐ (only) but zhī as the measure word for animals (一只猫).
- 不 becomes bú before a 4th tone: 不过 búguò, 不错 búcuò, 不要 búyào.

cards.Example: 我自己来。 wǒ zìjǐ lái: I'll do it myself.
cards.Notes: 自 self (picture of a nose: people point to the nose for 'me') + 己 self. 己 vs 已 yǐ vs 巳 sì

cards.Example: 你说得很好。 nǐ shuō de hěn hǎo: You speak well.
cards.Notes: 彳 step + 㝵 (a hand 寸 grabbing): getting. de in 说得好, dé in 得到, děi = have to

cards.Example: 他已经走了。 tā yǐjīng zǒu le: He's already gone.
cards.Notes: 已 already (half closed, vs 己 self) + 经 pass through = already been through

cards.Example: 如果下雨，我就不去。 rúguǒ xiàyǔ, wǒ jiù bú qù: If it rains, I won't go.
cards.Notes: 如 as, if (女 + 口) + 果 fruit, result = if it turns out

cards.Example: 我只有一个。 wǒ zhǐ yǒu yí ge: I only have one.
cards.Notes: 口 over 八. zhǐ = only; zhī counts animals and one of a pair (一只猫)

cards.Meaning: to serve as; when; right at
cards.Example: 他想当老师。 tā xiǎng dāng lǎoshī: He wants to be a teacher.
cards.Notes: Simplified from 當 (田 field + 尚 shàng for the sound)

cards.Meaning: to bring; to take along; belt
cards.Example: 别忘了带钱。 bié wàngle dài qián: Don't forget to bring money.
cards.Notes: A belt with cloth hanging from it (巾 cloth at the bottom)

cards.Example: 好吃，不过有点儿贵。 hǎochī, búguò yǒudiǎnr guì: Tasty, but a bit pricey.
cards.Notes: 不 not + 过 exceed = no more than: only; but

cards.Example: 不要说话。 búyào shuōhuà: Don't talk.
cards.Notes: 不 not + 要 want = don't (do it)

cards.Example: 我通过了考试。 wǒ tōngguòle kǎoshì: I passed the exam.
cards.Notes: 通 through (辶 + 甬 yǒng for the sound) + 过 pass = pass through

cards.Example: 过去的事别想了。 guòqù de shì bié xiǎng le: Let the past be the past.
cards.Notes: 过 pass + 去 go away = gone by. After a verb it's toneless: 走过去 zǒu guoqu

cards.Example: 结果怎么样？ jiéguǒ zěnmeyàng: How did it turn out?
cards.Notes: 结 tie, bear fruit (纟 + 吉 jí for the sound) + 果 fruit = what the plant bore: outcome

cards.Example: 这个菜不错。 zhège cài búcuò: This dish is pretty good.
cards.Notes: 不 not + 错 wrong = not wrong: pretty good

cards.Example: 老师要求很高。 lǎoshī yāoqiú hěn gāo: The teacher's standards are high.
cards.Notes: 要 yāo demand + 求 seek = demand. 要 is yāo here, not yào

cards.Example: 只要你来就好。 zhǐyào nǐ lái jiù hǎo: As long as you come, it's fine.
cards.Notes: 只 only + 要 need = only need: as long as

cards.Example: 我们的想法不同。 wǒmen de xiǎngfǎ bùtóng: We think differently.
cards.Notes: 不 not + 同 same (一 and 口 under one cover 冂) = not the same

cards.Meaning: to ask for; to beg; to seek
cards.Example: 我求你了！ wǒ qiú nǐ le: I'm begging you!
cards.Notes: Originally a picture of a fur coat, borrowed for 'seek'. Gives the sound in 球 qiú

cards.Example: 当时我不在家。 dāngshí wǒ bú zài jiā: I wasn't home then.
cards.Notes: 当 right at + 时 time = at that time

cards.Example: 他是我真正的朋友。 tā shì wǒ zhēnzhèng de péngyou: He's a real friend.
cards.Notes: 真 true + 正 upright, correct = truly genuine

cards.Example: 他们同时到了。 tāmen tóngshí dào le: They arrived at the same time.
cards.Notes: 同 same + 时 time

cards.Example: 越快越好。 yuè kuài yuè hǎo: The sooner the better.
cards.Notes: 走 walk + 戉 yuè (an axe) for the sound: stride across

cards.Example: 我来自中国。 wǒ láizì Zhōngguó: I'm from China.
cards.Notes: 来 come + 自 from = come from. 自 means both 'self' and 'from'

cards.Example: 你带来什么了？ nǐ dàilái shénme le: What did you bring?
cards.Notes: 带 carry + 来 come (toward me) = bring here

cards.Example: 你过来一下。 nǐ guòlai yíxià: Come over here a sec.
cards.Notes: 过 pass + 来 toward me = come over. Opposite: 过去

cards.Example: 这很正常。 zhè hěn zhèngcháng: That's normal.
cards.Notes: 正 correct + 常 usual (尚 + 巾) = proper and usual: normal

cards.Example: 别那样说。 bié nàyàng shuō: Don't say it like that.
cards.Notes: 那 that + 样 kind = that kind. Mirror: 这样

cards.Example: 原来是你！ yuánlái shì nǐ: Oh, it's you!
cards.Notes: 原 original + 来 come = as it originally was; also 'so that's it!'

cards.Example: 你觉得怎样？ nǐ juéde zěnyàng: What do you think?
cards.Notes: 怎 how (乍 + 心) + 样 kind = what kind: how. Same as 怎么样

cards.Example: 我每天经过这儿。 wǒ měitiān jīngguò zhèr: I pass by here every day.
cards.Notes: 经 pass through + 过 pass = go past

cards.Meaning: can only; have no choice but
cards.Example: 我只能等。 wǒ zhǐ néng děng: All I can do is wait.
cards.Notes: 只 only + 能 can

cards.Example: 我经常去那儿。 wǒ jīngcháng qù nàr: I go there often.
cards.Notes: 经 constant (纟: warp threads on a loom) + 常 usual = regularly

cards.Example: 我也有同样的问题。 wǒ yě yǒu tóngyàng de wèntí: I have the same problem.
cards.Notes: 同 same + 样 kind = the same kind

cards.Example: 天越来越冷了。 tiān yuèláiyuè lěng le: It's getting colder and colder.
cards.Notes: 越 the more + 来 come + 越 = more and more as time comes

cards.Example: 主要是没时间。 zhǔyào shì méi shíjiān: Mainly, there's no time.
cards.Notes: 主 main, master (a lamp: flame 丶 over its stand) + 要 important = main

cards.Example: 来了不少人。 láile bùshǎo rén: Quite a lot of people came.
cards.Notes: 不 not + 少 few = not few. 少 shǎo vs 小 xiǎo: 少 adds a ノ

cards.Example: 他超过了我。 tā chāoguòle wǒ: He overtook me.
cards.Notes: 超 leap over (走 + 召 zhào for the sound) + 过 pass = surpass

cards.Example: 我爱吃水果，比如苹果。 wǒ ài chī shuǐguǒ, bǐrú píngguǒ: I love fruit, apples for example.
cards.Notes: 比 compare (two people side by side) + 如 like = compare to: for example

cards.Example: 后来他走了。 hòulái tā zǒu le: Later he left.
cards.Notes: 后 after + 来 come = what came after. Only for past events (以后 can be future)

cards.Example: 我想要自由。 wǒ xiǎng yào zìyóu: I want freedom.
cards.Notes: 自 self + 由 from, follow = following oneself: free
